title: 14 Thoſe do ſlaunder vs falſely, which ſaye, that we diſalowe good works.

segments.text: THey that do ſaye that we diſalowe good workes becauſe we ſaye that we be iuſtified by Ieſus Chriſt only apprehended by onely faith, do plainly and falſely ſlander vs. But we confeſſe that to geue God all the glorie, and confirme our ſelues to his holye worde▪ we differ from them in the matter of good works in three principall poyntes. For in the reſt• it is ſo farre from vs to ſaye that Chriſtians ought not to do good works▪ and abſtaine from euyll, that contrarywiſe we ſay that he lyeth falſely, which calleth him ſelfe a Chriſtian, and doeth not ſtudie to eſche we the euyll, and doo good. But this is it wherein lyeth our difference of this matter.
